purpose: Use the already-established endpoint-safe within-species self-detectability method as a positive structural anchor for the two completed insect panels, without changing either completed cross-species primary decision.

method_inheritance.panel_statistic: arithmetic mean of finite evaluation-species self-field Spearman scores

empirical_rule.response: the exact already-frozen post-IBD edge response definition used in that panel
empirical_rule.p_value: upper Monte Carlo p against the panel-specific 1000-world null reference

interpretation.if_self_positive_and_cross_species_negat: Spatial genetic structure is detectable within species but not reusable across species under the tested cross-species predictor; this provides a positive structural contrast rather than a global absence-of-signal explanation.
interpretation.claim_boundary: This application was frozen after the cross-species primary outcomes were known. It is a post-primary structural anchor using a pre-existing method, not a prospective rescue of either primary test.
